construct: CHILD ORDER that varies on one enum axis — the container's flex-direction keyword is `row` for BOTH values and the DOM order of the two children is reversed instead (the fluent.switch / fluent.spinner labelPosition shape)
why: The union anatomy collapses every combo's children into ONE part order and emits `union-order-drift` about it, and enrichLayout reads only `el.node.style[channel]` — no reader anywhere between capture and contract consumes child order. Both enum values therefore mint the base order, so two distinct variants render byte-identically. The schema already owns the spelling: VariantLayoutSchema's REVERSED directions are documented as "the canvas (which has no reverse) reverses the compiled child order per variant instead".

canvas.note: the `before` variant compiles with the two children in the opposite order (isReversed -> spec.children.reverse())
